xna-type.name: NotificationPosition
xna-type.summary: Determines where notifications appear on the screen. Used to specify the notification position for the NotificationPosition property.

member.name: BottomCenter
member.summary: Positions the message box at the bottom of the screen and centered.

member.name: BottomLeft
member.summary: Positions the message box at the bottom-left of the screen.

member.name: BottomRight
member.summary: Positions the message box at the bottom-right of the screen.

member.name: Center
member.summary: Positions the message box at the center of the screen.

member.name: CenterLeft
member.summary: Positions the message box at the center of the screen and left-aligned.

member.name: CenterRight
member.summary: Positions the message box at the center of the screen and right-aligned.

member.name: TopCenter
member.summary: Positions the message box at the top of the screen and centered.

member.name: TopLeft
member.summary: Positions the message box at the top-left of the screen.

member.name: TopRight
member.summary: Positions the message box at the top-right of the screen.
